com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.component

Interface IComponentType

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IHasModelObject, IIdentifiable, IModelAbstraction

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IComponentType
extends IIdentifiable

    An IComponentType represents a software component type according to AUTOSAR. It might define functionality and behavior of a software component in case of an atomic component type, contain other software components and connections in case of a composition component type or define parameters and characteristic values in case of a parameter component type.

    IComponent is an instance of a software component type.

      • supportsMultipleInstantiation

        @PublishedMethod
boolean supportsMultipleInstantiation()
        Component types that support multiple instantiation can have more than one component prototype instance. In other words multiple component prototypes can reference the same component type if the type supports multiple instantiation.
        Returns:
        True if the IComponentType supports multiple instantiation, false otherwise.
